notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.content:
Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers!


We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for Pizza Slice - our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from August 26th until September 16th. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s Steam Store Page and click the green “Request Access” button to be viable for participation.



It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). 

Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy![previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]

🍕About Pizza Slice


If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area!
Game features:[p align="justify"]• The Dream - Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis. • The Business - owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.

• The Buzz - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores. • A cozy simulation - the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business. • A portion for two - you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! 


[hr][/hr]

🥓What can you expect from the build?


A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.



The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.



Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.


[hr][/hr]

🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?
We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested, and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.



The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.

Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.

Build Information & Requirements

Platform: Windows PC via Steam

Controller Support: Partial Support

Supported Languages - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.

Hardware Minimum Requirements:

Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer

Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz

4 GB RAM

Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x

DirectX 11

6 GB free HDD Space



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45047327/e00c11da06afea0c97c450539317f9ff2161465d.png"]



[hr][/hr]

🤌How to Join?[olist]
Go to the Pizza Slice Steam Page now. You can follow the link HERE.

Click on the Request Access button found on the playtest section of the page.

That’s it! You’re signed in. Now patiently await for a confirmation email.

The playtests will begin on August 26th, 2025.
[/olist]

👌Got questions?
The easiest way to ask us questions is by joining our Discord server and asking us directly. 





[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdgxrgVF4rsFiLGxN6XXtLCul8Bc6Ar21tfewUVXyPhEJ7Qf6BMZ1GFIy80DV1hYG_lCxabprQ-e1bHlI4NI521-UceWfDo4kNNpgzg4V6_kZEOyjR0P9bHw58okn-N0ldqLyAIZg?key=4PCsGwNRpUgMuhXU8r85kA"]




See you at the table, really soon!



The Gaming Factory Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153410/JDM_Japanese_Drift_Master/ 
This is a unique game born out of our deep love for cars and passion for Japanese culture.

Get ready to explore the open world of Guntama – a city full of atmospheric streets, mountain passes, and iconic, fully licensed cars. Drift through the corners, tune your vehicles, and follow Touma’s journey through a story-rich manga-style narrative. All of that wrapped in a vibrant soundtrack and a visually engaging world.

notes.title: Ghost Keeper Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Little Bugs,

We’re proud to announce a new title releasing in the year 2025 - Ghost Keeper. Take on the role of an acolyte tasked with scaring mortals. Inspired by the classic, Ghost Master, the upcoming game will introduce you to the grotesque world of the Victorian era.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/

Manage monsters and wraiths whose unique abilities will help you spread fear among the living. Face the ghost-hating Brotherhood, who will do anything to thwart your plans. Stay alert and devise the best tactics. You are not alone in your adventure, as a demonic partner accompanies you every step of the way. His hilarious comments add charm to the ever-present aura of horror. Look what we prepared for you in this title:

[previewyoutube=LVfs-iHNUvw;full][/previewyoutube]
Ghost Keeper combines elements known from old-school games with modern innovations and mechanics. It will work perfectly for both those familiar with retro titles and those trying the genre for the first time. 

Add the game to your wishlist on Steam and look forward to further information. Feel free to join us on Discord, where you'll experience horror and laughter, and check out our brand new Twitter / X !

notes.content:
Dear Little Bugs

We’re proud to present the new title published by Gaming Factory on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox - Puppet House! This atmospheric and terrifying survival horror will take you straight to Field Town and the mysterious mansion that belonged to deceased ventriloquist Peter Hill.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707710/Puppet_House 

As Rick Evans, a photographer with a penchant for haunted places, you will be tasked with discovering what secrets lie behind the disappearances of people who have crossed the threshold of this nightmarish house. The mansion is filled with puzzles that will put your wit and perceptiveness to the test. They will also bring you closer to the terrifying truth that Peter Hill has hidden in his mansion.

Add Puppet House to your Steam wishlist so you don't miss out on future updates. We also encourage you to watch the trailer announcing the game and visit the official website.

Check our free demo! Play a stylized tower defense game with a local co-op!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/

[previewyoutube=PvSMZIoRC3Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Lesson Learned is a co-op game offering unique approach to the tower defense genre mixed with crafting, resource gathering, and RTS elements. In the game, you'll gather resources, build defenses, and try to survive waves of historically inaccurate enemies, from cavemen to Roman legionaries, medieval knights, the French Imperial Army, and soldiers. Free your classmates to expand your crew of minions and, with their help, try to get yourselves out of this predicament. Hopefully.

In the demo Lesson Learned we allow players to go through 3 levels of the campaign that end with a clash with the powerful Caesar! We also decided to give you the chance to play 3 levels of multiplayer skirmishes in co-op mode with your friends.

notes.title: Back2School - big discounts and a bundle
notes.content:
Hello!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32971356/cb1309be5ca688bafd8b13b5ab5989cd689c9826.png

Holidays are over, it's time to go back to school. After school though it's best to relax a bit and have some fun. We have prepared for you a bundle great for that and of course the discount for this game.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27707/Back2School/

Here are the games you will get in the bundle:

 Bakery Simulator
 ZooKeeper
 Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)
 Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator
 Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator
 Commander '85
 Pangeon
 Foodtruck Arena
 Bouncy Bob: Episode 2
 Gunslingers & Zombies

 1. Bug Academy + Dlc (Artistic Kit)) where you learn Physics- How the furniture in the apartment reacts when a refrigerator enters it through the window, Mathematics - Calculating the angle account when throwing cows to the fence, and Art - Painting pictures while having fun with tossing cows and smashing everything.

2. ZooKeeper  where you learn Natural Sciences - different animal species, their reactions, and characteristics and Business Studies - the basics of ZOO, animals, and staff management while having the pleasure of watching animals and creating your own zoo

3. Bakery Simulator where you learn Cooking - Baking to be precise. You will get a basic knowledge how what the baking process looks like and you find out what kind of machines bakers use and have fun baking your favorite bread in the game and then doing it in real life! 

4. Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator where you learn Technology - many kinds of bombs that can be found nowadays, how to disarm them, and how dangerous the sapper's job can really be and have fun searching for a bomb and having the thrill of disarming it just in time.

5. Gallic Wars - Battle Simulator where you learn History - Never heard of ancient times? Romans, Gauls? Those two nations didn't like each other too much. Physics - what can happen if a catapult's stone hit a big group of units? Have fun using magic, traps, and catapults.

6. Commander '85 where you learn History - Experience what it was like in the 1980s. How some feared war and feared new technologies coming into our lives... The rise of computers Science - Find out how computers worked in the 1980s, and how hard it was to operate them compared to the present while having fun with challenging gameplay, where there are no tutorials, no help, no easy solutions. There is only you, a small monitor screen, and commands.

7. Pangeon where you learn IT - how to use only pixels, that create blurry pictures to make a game in the times of hyper-realistic graphics while having fun searching the dungeons and killing monsters.

8. Foodtruck Arena where you learn PE - In most physical challenges, good cooperation is always vital. It is not different here. Arena, football, cars, cooperation. That's quite a good combo to get a lot of fun.

9. Bouncy Bob: Episode 2 where you learn what to do on School break - how to cope with your friends when no one tells you what to do or not do!

10. Gunslingers & Zombies - Face Zombie Apocalypse in Wild West. Manage your crew in a Turn-based strategy and adventure game. Survive, scavenge, and explore the world. Use the different talents of your team members and develop your tactics. Resolve the zombie mystery.


When your mom comes in saying "stop playing, it's time to learn something" - you just need to show this.

One more thing... Check our upcoming game Electrician Simulator!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator/

Good Luck and Have Fun, fellow gamers! :)
